4251.title: De ingang van het park van Saint-Cloud in Parijs
4251.creator: Unknown

editorial.note: Kleijn verbleef twee jaar in Parijs met subsidie van koning Lodewijk Napoleon. Daar schilderde hij het park van het Château de Saint-Cloud, ten westen van Parijs. De lage zon werpt lange slagschaduwen op de zandgrond.
Voogd werd de ‘Hollandse Claude’ genoemd, naar de Franse schilder Claude Lorrain, die beroemd was om zijn historische landschappen, badend in gouden licht.

144822.creator: Paulus Constantijn la Fargue

editorial.note: La Fargue specialized in topographical views, that is, accurate illustrations of specific places.

Adriaen van Ostade from Haarlem painted not only a great many genre scenes with farming folk, but also several landscapes. This painting, with its dramatic contrast between light and shadow, betrays the influence of Rembrandt.

editorial.note: Oil on canvas. The American Wing.
This landscape is clearly constructed and painted in detail. You can see everything very distinctly: the ground, the trees, the sky.
The rapid, powerful brushwork of this landscape makes it look more like an oil sketch than a finished painting. As such, Tavenraat deviated from the path taken by most Dutch painters at the time.
Of all Dutch landscape painters, Koekkoek is perhaps the most Romantic.
